source.name: Most frequent words: Ukrainian (wordfreq, English Wiktionary)
source.notes:
The 6,000 most frequent Ukrainian words, in frequency order.
Frequency: wordfreq 3.1 "large" list (rspeer/wordfreq; data CC BY-SA 4.0), which combines Wikipedia, OpenSubtitles, web text, Twitter and Reddit.
Lemmatization: michmech/lemmatization-lists Ukrainian (ODbL 1.0) and the inflection tables in dmklinger/ukrainian, plus Wiktionary headwords
Disambiguation: UD Ukrainian IU treebank (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), used only to split ambiguous forms; none of its text is included
Definitions and parts of speech: English Wiktionary, via the Wiktextract/Kaikki.org extraction in Vuizur/Wiktionary-Dictionaries (2022–23 snapshot; CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL)
Words without an entry in the main dictionary (tagged fallback-dictionary): dmklinger/ukrainian, a Ukrainian–English dictionary compiled from English Wiktionary and DBnary (June 2026; CC BY-SA 3.0)
Stress marks: Wiktionary forms, else dmklinger/ukrainian (whose inflection tables come from the ULIF grammatical dictionary).
Declension tables: dmklinger/ukrainian (CC BY-SA 3.0; tables from the ULIF grammatical dictionary), with stress; else UniMorph Ukrainian (CC BY-SA 3.0) or the forms annotated in the UD IU treebank (annotations only, no text).
Example sentences: Tatoeba (CC-BY-2.0-FR); UD Ukrainian IU (CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, non-commercial use only); AI-written (Claude) (AI-generated, not checked by a native speaker); the source of every sentence is listed in uk-sentence-credits.tsv.
See docs/VOCABULARY_SOURCES.md for licences and attribution.
